data.description: Treasure Hunter is the treasure hunt quest you take from the Hunter at the [Ranch](/monument/ranch) or [Large Barn](/monument/large-barn). Reach the location you're given and you'll find a Treasure Mission Box with 5 scrap guaranteed, about a 49% shot at an [SMG body](/items/smg-body) and 42% each at HQM, pipes and [tech trash](/items/tech-trash). You've got 6 hours to get there. Finish it and it's back after an hour; fail it and it's back in 5 minutes.
